description: This file defines the MyEmailsDashlet class, a custom dashboard widget for displaying emails within SugarCRM / SuiteCRM. It includes class methods for construction, processing email data, and rendering embedded JavaScript for UI interactions.

classes.name: MyEmailsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying and managing emails in the SuiteCRM SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dashlet properties, loading metadata, and setting default title, columns, and seed bean.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes email data with filtering options and custom SQL joins, preparing data for display.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Generates embedded JavaScript for UI interactions, such as quick-create dialog boxes with icons.
